title: Why am I obsessed with China’s ancient golden age? I took my daughter on a trip to find out
description: I felt a duty to write about the Tang dynasty and its incredible social and cultural sophistication – but also to connect my Chinese past with my child During the Tang dynasty , which lasted from the seventh to the early 10th century, Vikings were raiding the coasts of what today is called Europe. In the small archipelago now known as Britain, Anglo-Saxon kingdoms flitted by. Meanwhile, in Mesoamerica, after 3,000 years of flourishing, the Maya civilisation was collapsing . In the east, China had been united for nine centuries and the Tang dynasty was already a proverbial high point of world culture. Continue reading...
